signal: Foursquare has fully repositioned as a location-data infrastructure provider, deprecating legacy V3 endpoints and pushing its 2026 digital overlap and attribution products

email.body1:
Stephanie, saw Foursquare has leaned fully into the location-data infrastructure story with the 2026 overlap and attribution products.

A repositioning like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the group sales team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Foursquare off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Stephanie, quick follow-up for Foursquare.

As the infrastructure story broadens the buyer set, the account list grows faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Foursquare needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Stephanie, last bit of proof for Foursquare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Foursquare's reply rate likely compares to other location-data teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Stephanie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A repositioning is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a location-data motion? I will tailor it to Foursquare either way.
